title: Biological replication, statistics and uncertainty
intro: From image-level measurements to biologically defensible analysis: joins, experimental units, exclusions, matched designs, cluster bootstrap and transparent figures.

scientific_context.caution: A methodologically correct animal-level computation does not establish causality or effect significance in new biological experiments.

chapter_method: Predict → Run → Investigate → Apply → independent Prove → delayed review, then real local CSV bootstrap and plots.

goals.title: Join measurements to trustworthy sample metadata
goals.why: Invalid joins can quietly assign cells to the wrong animal or experimental condition.
explain: Declare one-to-one field IDs rather than relying on row order.
Duplicate metadata keys must be rejected or investigated.
A complete join is necessary, but does not prove biological independence.
